**Role:** Powertrain Lead, overseeing engine design. **Target:** engine running with all needed technical components by Dec 12.

The car runs a Honda CBR600F4i engine. My team designs the systems that keep it cooled and fueled, and I coordinate with the chassis, suspension, and electrical teams so everything packages together and can be built and serviced.
